messages:
emma: Ok team — FinServe POC kickoff. Need to confirm scope, success criteria, timeline, and who we need from SE/eng. Customer wants a 4-week pilot proving retrieval+generation for statements reconciliation. Who can support?

raj: I can lead SE work. Quick q: is customer data staying in their VPC/on-prem? Security Qs will drive deployment model.

maria: Quick proposal for success criteria so we have something to iterate on:
- end-to-end demo with <1s p50 generation for 512 tokens
- 85%+ correctness on a 50-prompt eval set (business definitions based)
- Observability: token-level cost + per-route latency in console
- Auth+audit: SSO + audit logs enabled
- Cost target: rough estimate <= $350 per 100k requests (ballpark)

tyler: CS can run prompt evals and collect feedback from their SMEs. I'll own the weekly evals + demo cadence. Weekly Fridays for demo?

olivia: For SE deliverables: integration guide, sample S3 connector, eval-harness repo, and canary runbook. Rough estimate: 1.5 SE-weeks to build connectors, 0.5 for runbook and docs.

sec-bot: Security questionnaire uploaded: https://redwood-sec/finserve-sq-v3.pdf — customer flagged SOC2, TLS mTLS, and HSM for key management.

emma: Pricing / credits: We can offer 30k trial tokens + up to 2 SE days as free enablement. If they want Dedicated capacity, estimate 2–3 week lead time and a minimum commit. Raj, can you confirm Dedicated feasibility?

raj: Dedicated / Private will need infra sign-off. Opening infra ticket now. Blocker: customer insists on HSM integration for key wrapping — need to check KMS/HSM support plan.

maria: Draft timeline (4 weeks):
```
Week 0: Onboard + security questionnaire done
Week 1: Connector + ingestion + dev sandbox
Week 2: Prompt tuning + evals (50 prompts)
Week 3: Perf tuning + canary in staging
Week 4: Final demo + handover + SOW/next steps
```

olivia: Resource ask: 2 SE days Week0 (onboarding), 3 engineer-days Weeks1-2 (connectors + tuning), 1 runtime engineer Week3 for perf tuning. Need a green light from eng-sre for canary infra.

tyler: I'll coordinate the customer PM for data access and user stories. Proposed recurring Friday demos at 11am PT starting next Friday.

emma: Action items (owners + due dates):
- raj: open infra ticket for HSM + Dedicated feasibility (due in 2 business days)
- olivia: share connector repo template + refined estimate (due in 3 days)
- tyler: schedule recurring demos and upload initial prompt set (due EOD today)
- maria: finalize success criteria with customer and confirm eval metrics (due in 2 days)
I'll follow up with an SOW sketch and credit details.

raj: Noted, starting the infra ticket now. Will escalate to infra leads if we hit policy blocks.

olivia: I'll post the initial repo and README by tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

tyler: Calendar invite sent. cc @emma

emma: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. If HSM or Dedicated becomes a hard blocker we can propose a hybrid: hosted with strict data filters + customer-managed encryption keys as interim. Next sync if needed Wednesday.
